about_the_game:
Additional downloadable content that adds 10 more fan-voted titles for Raidou.

*This content will be available once the player is able to manually change their title in-game by reaching the required rank.
*For further information on how to change titles, please see "How to Use Downloadable Content" in the in-game Detective Journal.
*Titles included in this DLC vary by language.

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains violence, blood & gore, partial nudity, and suggestive themes.
